# Minimal, actionable questions

Ask only when an essential scope, requirement, target branch, contradictory fact
or side-effect gate cannot be resolved from available evidence. Start with a
read-only repository scan and current project context. Ask **one focused question
at a time** during Configure; elsewhere group tightly related blockers when that
is clearer. Explain the decision the answer unlocks and offer an evidence-backed
option plus a neutral alternative. Never ask for a credential value.

For full ticket-to-plan analysis confirm ticket ID, explicit planning intent and
test branch. If provider fetch fails, retry once, then request ticket title,
description and acceptance criteria instead of blocking indefinitely. A missing
optional integration does not justify repeated questions or invented results.
When ambiguity is non-blocking, mark it and proceed with bounded assumptions.

At action gates show exact changed paths, command, target/environment, risks and
expected side effects. Approval to design does not authorise test generation,
branch creation, full/shared test runs, publication, pushes or installation.
For Jira/Confluence show the exact content and confirmed destination immediately
before asking for explicit affirmative publication approval; ask again after edits.
